cat > .probe/cases.py <<'PY'
import subprocess, os
exe='/workspace/executable'; book='/workspace/.probe/book'
def run(args,data=None,cwd=book,env=None):
 r=subprocess.run([exe]+args,cwd=cwd,input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env)
 print('\n$',args,'->',r.returncode);print('OUT',repr(r.stdout.decode()));print('ERR',repr(r.stderr.decode()));return r
if __name__=='__main__':
 for a in [ ['new','--no-input','--id','abc','--title','My test','--date','2023-01-02','--dry-run'],['new','--no-input','--id','abc','-p','-t','My test'],['new','--no-input','--id','abc','-p'],['new','--no-input','-n','--id','z','--date','bad'],['new','--no-input','-n','--id','def'],['index','-v'],['list'],['list','-f','json'],['list','-f','jsonl'],['tag','list']]:run(a)
PY
python3 .probe/cases.py
cat > .probe/book/alpha.md <<'EOF'
---
title: "Front Alpha"
tags: [red, green, two words]
date: 2021-02-03
created: 2020-01-01T12:30:00Z
modified: 2022-03-04
aliases: [A, Aleph]
custom: value
---
# Alpha **bold** and [link](https://example.com)

First paragraph with #inline-tag and #nested/tag.
Second line.

[Beta](sub/beta.md) and [[gamma]] and [[nonexistent|Unknown]].

`#not-tag` ![Image](pic.png) [Alpha self](alpha.md#section)
EOF
mkdir -p .probe/book/sub
cat > .probe/book/sub/beta.md <<'EOF'
# Beta Title

A beta note. Alpha bold and link is here.

#red #green #UPPER #with_under #123 :colon:tag:
[[alpha|Alpha Wiki]]

## Subheading
Text **bold** and *italic* `code`.
EOF
cat > .probe/book/gamma.md <<'EOF'
Title setext
============

Something with no tags. [Link Beta](sub/beta.md "Desc").
EOF
cat > .probe/book/no-title.md <<'EOF'
No title on this note.

# Not first header

Body is here.
EOF
printf '\n' > .probe/book/empty.md
cat > .probe/formats.py <<'PY'
from cases import run
run(['index','-v'])
for f in ['oneline','short','medium','long','full','json','jsonl','path','{{path}} | {{filename}} | {{filename-stem}} | {{title}} | {{title-or-path}} | {{word-count}} | {{tags}} | {{body}}']:
 run(['list','--sort','path','-f',f])
for f in ['name','full','json','jsonl','{{name}}|{{note-count}}']:
 run(['tag','list','--sort','name','-f',f])
run(['graph','-f','json','-s','path'])
PY
python3 .probe/formats.py

p='tests/test_cli.py';s=open(p).read();idx=s.index('    def test_argument_errors(self):');s=s[:idx]+'''    def test_working_directory_paths(self):
        self.note('top.md', '# Top\\n\\n[[sub/child]]\\n')
        self.note('sub/child.md', '# Child\\n')
        result = self.run_cli('--notebook-dir', str(self.book), 'list', '-q', '-s', 'path', '-f', 'path', cwd=self.book.parent)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'notes/sub/child.md\\nnotes/top.md\\n')
        result = self.run_cli('list', '-q', '-s', 'path', '-f', '{{path}}|{{link}}', cwd=self.book / 'sub')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'child.md|[[sub/child]]\\n../top.md|[[top]]\\n')
        result = self.run_cli('list', '.', '-q', '-f', 'path', cwd=self.book / 'sub')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'child.md\\n')
        result = self.run_cli('list', '-L', 'top', '-q', '-f', 'path', cwd=self.book / 'sub')
        self.assertIn('could not find notes at: sub/top', result.stderr)

    def test_lsp_handshake(self):
        request = json.dumps({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 1, 'method': 'initialize', 'params': {'capabilities': {}}})
        payload = 'Content-Length: ' + str(len(request.encode())) + '\\r\\n\\r\\n' + request
        result = self.run_cli('lsp', input=payload)
        # Text-mode capture normalizes CRLF framing to LF.
        response = json.loads(result.stdout.split('\\n\\n', 1)[1])
        self.assertEqual(response['id'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response['result']['serverInfo'], {'name': 'zk', 'version': 'dev'})
        self.assertEqual(response['result']['capabilities']['textDocumentSync']['change'], 2)

''' +s[idx:];open(p,'w').write(s)
